relations.subject: n1ql:cbo-stats-storage
relations.note: subject deliberately is the storage collection, not n1ql:update-statistics itself — running UPDATE STATISTICS does not itself require system-administrator privileges, but directly accessing/dropping the collection it writes to does
relations.evidence: Access to this bucket, scope, and collection is restricted to system administrators. Regular users do not have access to the bucket, scope, or collection. Users with system administration privileges can access or drop them.
